questions.subject: Biology
questions.stem: Which of the following is not an attribute of a population?
questions.answer_note: Population attributes include sex ratio, natality and mortality; species interaction describes a relationship between populations or species.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacid of sulphur has an –O–O– linkage?
questions.answer_note: Peroxodisulphuric acid contains a peroxide –O–O– linkage.
questions.verification_status: visually verified against official NTA English E1 PDF, page 13, question 101
questions.editorial_note: This is a valid chemistry-recall item. It does not directly observe clinical judgment, communication, ethics, reliability or care.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.stem: Which option correctly describes the free expansion of an ideal gas under adiabatic conditions?
questions.answer_note: There is no heat exchange or boundary work; for an ideal gas the internal energy and temperature remain unchanged.
questions.verification_status: question number and wording visually verified against official NTA English E1 PDF; key supplied by extracted package
